mostWorthwhile.text: Comparing baptismal water with asking a saint to pray was most worthwhile: it showed why an example of God working through something does not settle whether to address a departed person.

leastWorthwhile.text: The painting combination was clear but predictable; it largely restated the distinction already supplied in the items.

surprise.text: The initially unclear comparison with baptism clarified that water is not a person being asked to pray.

arbitrary.text: The baptism comparison initially seemed a little arbitrary, though its result explained the relevance and limits of the analogy.

continue.text: I would continue: the comparisons make room for useful distinctions without pretending they resolve every disagreement.
